name: deckpet
description: Windows desktop pets as a graphical front-end for Agent CLIs (ACP-first, multi-backend)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:pipeline
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/pet/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/pet/bundle.js && esbuild src/renderer/settings/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/settings/bundle.js && esbuild src/renderer/reader/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/reader/bundle.js && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
